**Lockhart Wharf Narrowboat Hire: fleet and hire register**

**Fleet.** Lady Margaret has a hull length of 2057 cm and 9 berths. Her last hull survey was on 2025-05-14.

**Skippers.** Giles Pemberton can be reached at seun.adeyemi@example.org or on 07700 900845.

**Crew postings.**
- Hannah Whitcombe serves as deckhand on Marsh Harrier from 2023-03-18, with no end date known.
- Priya Raman serves as crew on Lady Margaret from 2023-05-06, with no end date known.
- Priya Raman serves as crew on Copper Kettle from 2024-03-23, with no end date known. This corrects an earlier entry, and the boat is the detail that changed.
- Giles Pemberton serves as deckhand on Lady Margaret from 2023-09-30, with no end date known.

**Hires.**
- Lady Margaret was hired by Marguerite Ashworth for 2 nights. She was picked up at Cuttle Bridge Moorings and collected at Hatherley Top Lock Wharf. The hire started on 2024-07-05 and ended on 2026-10-20. The charge was 21500 minor units of EUR, and the deposit was 15000 minor units of CAD.
- Willow Wren was hired by Aisha Khalid for 5 nights. She was picked up at Cuttle Bridge Moorings and collected at Lockhart Wharf Main Basin. The hire started on 2024-09-20 and ended on 2024-11-06. The charge was 119000 minor units of AUD, and no deposit was taken.
- Lady Margaret was hired by Giles Pemberton for 3 nights. He picked her up at Hatherley Top Lock Wharf, and she is to be collected at Lockhart Wharf Main Basin. The hire started on 2025-07-26 and has no end date, so the boat is still out. The charge was 52000 minor units of NOK, and the deposit was 20000 minor units of JPY.
- Wandering Swan was hired by Marguerite Ashworth for 14 nights. She was picked up at Lockhart Wharf Main Basin and collected at Hatherley Top Lock Wharf. The hire started on 2026-10-09 and ended on 2025-06-13. The charge was 78500 minor units of GBP, and the deposit was 25000 minor units of DKK.
- Wandering Swan was hired by Priya Raman for 3 nights. She was picked up at Brindley Lock Landing and collected at Marlow Reach Staithe. The hire started on 2025-09-13 and ended on 2024-07-09. The charge was 52000 minor units of DKK, and the deposit was 18000 minor units of CHF.
